newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian insolvencies down 71 pct in first quarter.
newsitem.headline: Austrian insolvencies down 71 pct in first quarter.

text.p: Austrian insolvency liabilities fell to 6.1 billion schillings in the first quarter of this year, a 71 percent drop on year-ago figures bloated by the collapse of builder Maculan, credit protection agency KSV said on Thursday.
Maculan accounted for 11.1 billion schillings of the 20.9 billion insolvency liabilities recorded in the first three months of 1996.
In a statement, KSV said the number of insolvencies in the first quarter of this year fell by around a third to 1,169 from 1,737.
The bulk of company failures were in the construction sector which accounted for 1.7 billion schillings in liabilities. -- Vienna Newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
